## Interfaces

- contract `project:backlog-item` create/list/supersede matches skills docs and CLI tests
- dashboard model loads the same open status=open records handoff selects
- dashboard promote/dismiss call the same supersede shapes engage documents
- feedback remains a separate observation type; skills and tests keep it distinct

## Assumptions

- current-status supersede is legal for backlog-item (confirmed by CLI tests)
- Wave-2 tasks did not edit contract/; skills/dashboard/tests stay coherent with wave-1 contract
- Needs you vocabulary unchanged; backlog is a separate panel

## Invariants

- Feedback never stores deferred backlog
- Only status=open items appear in handoff and Backlog panel
- Structured promote still routes to discuss (prompt), not in-process skill run
- Needs you never lists backlog items

## Conflicts

none
